The question asks for the ids of all TV channels that have more than two TV series.  
We need to count the number of TV series per channel and return the channel ids where that count is greater than 2.

```sql
SELECT Channel
FROM TV_series
GROUP BY Channel
HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;
```

FINAL SQL:
SELECT Channel
FROM TV_series
GROUP BY Channel
HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;
